name: Skin Aurora — Cuerpo
generation_strategy: IMAGEN COMBINADA 1536×1024: skin body (izquierda) + cañón temático (derecha).

frames.role: Cuerpo del tanque skin Aurora (hielo/aurora boreal) — skin legendaria
frames.prompt:
TWO cartoon tank sprites side by side on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Both viewed strictly from directly above at 90 degrees (bird's eye zenith view, only TOP SURFACE visible). STYLE: vibrant cool cartoon art, Brawl Stars quality, bold dark charcoal outlines, smooth cel-shading gradients.

LEFT PANEL — AURORA TANK BODY (ice/aurora borealis legendary skin): Bright cyan-turquoise (#00BBCC) tank body. The roof surface has: layered armor panels with small crystalline diamond accent shapes on the panel lines, circular turret ring with a frost effect, armored hatch with ice crystal detail, subtle snowflake-like geometric engravings. TWO SEGMENTED TRACK STRIPS on left/right edges (cool dark teal-gray, individual track links). Cel-shading: bright white icy glowing highlight, rich cyan mid-tone, dark teal shadow. A subtle cool white-cyan edge glow suggesting cold energy. Chunky squat proportions.

RIGHT PANEL — AURORA CANNON (matching ice theme): Narrow elongated rectangle pointing UP, base wider. Bright cyan-white (#00DDEE) with white highlight stripe, cool teal shadow. Matching aurora aesthetic. Bold charcoal outline.

Strictly top-down. NO front/side face. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, military realism, orange/red warm colors, dark, gritty, text, watermark, background scenery, multiple tanks
